hppSubtitle: Production cost (IDR). Scan is metered by SKU seats, not credits.
hppRatesHint: Variable cost per scan type (not per-seat SKU list price).
hppRatesCogsVsPrice: These are production costs (COGS) per completed job — not selling prices. The line-margin cards compute revenue from the SKU list price in the catalog.
hppRatesEmpty: No HPP rates yet. Run migrations to seed keys.
hppReportHint: HPP = rate × volume. Fully loaded = HPP + overhead pool share (singleton + journal).
hppSkuHint: Estimasi — list × orgs with an enabled Scan schedule or a Host site, minus fully loaded COGS. Host COGS is capped at included cadence (sites × days in range) when lab/manual volume exceeds that. Not invoice P&L.
hppHostCogsCapped: Host COGS capped at included cadence ({{cap}} scans vs {{raw}} recorded).
hppEnterpriseUnpriced: Enterprise orgs are quote-only (no public list price) and excluded from this estimasi: {{count}} org.
hppSeedPriceWarning: Some SKU list prices fall back to built-in seed constants (no catalog row): {{skus}}.
hppOverheadHint: Rent and Cloudflare (IDR / month). Allocated by unit volume in the report range — not mixed into unit rates.
hppCostsHint: Production costs by date (rent, Cloudflare, APIs). Summed into the report overhead pool for the selected range — not invoices.
hppCostsEmpty: No cost lines in this range.

simSubtitle: What-if simulation from your assumptions — not actual data.
simBanner: SCENARIO — not actual data. Numbers here are computed from your assumptions and are not saved.
simInputsHint: Enter the monthly fixed cost (overhead + journal), then volume, unit cost, and selling price per service. Price can be picked per SKU.
skuHint: List prices and SKU availability for invoicing. Seats follow the tier cap, not here.
skuLockWarning: List prices are commercial decisions. Editing a price does not change past invoices — each invoice stores the amount at creation.
skuSeatsReadonly: Seats are fixed by the tier cap (Basic 1 / Pro 3 / Multi 10) and cannot be edited here.
simPriceMissing: SKU price is missing from the catalog — enter it manually or set it in the SKU Catalog.
simGuideHint: Steps, formulas, and limits of the simulation.
simGuideStep1: Enter the monthly fixed cost (overhead + journal) — one lump sum for all services.
simGuideStep2: For each service, enter the volume (units/customers you assume).
simGuideStep3: Enter the unit cost (production cost per unit) — this is COGS, not the selling price.
simGuideStep4: Enter the selling price, or pick a SKU for Scan/Host to prefill it from the SKU catalog.
simGuideStep5: Read the HPP, margin, margin %, and break-even (BEP) columns.
simGuideStep6: Optional: enter a target margin to see the target price per service.
simGuideFixedCostTitle: How the fixed cost is split
simGuideFixedCostBody: The fixed cost is allocated proportionally to volume, with the rounding remainder going to the last service that has volume. A service with volume 0 gets no share — fill volume for every service you want to bear fixed cost.
simGuideFormulaBody: HPP = volume x unit cost. Fully loaded = HPP + fixed-cost share. Margin = revenue - fully loaded. Margin % = round(margin x 100 / revenue). BEP = ceil(fixed share / (price - unit cost)). Target price = (unit cost + fixed share / volume) / (1 - target margin).
simGuideNotComputedBody: Shown when unit cost plus fixed share is zero, or when volume is zero. The page never shows a confident percentage while cost is empty, because that number would be misleading.
simGuideLimit1: Nothing is saved — refreshing or leaving the page clears your inputs.
simGuideLimit2: This page never changes real data: no writes to HPP rates, overhead, journal, catalog, or invoices.
simGuideLimit3: Scan and Host are computed automatically; Uptime and Guard are manual assumptions only (no HPP cost key, no catalog price).
simGuideLimit4: Seat caps are not applied here — caps are enforced when assets are created, not in what-if math.
simGuideLimit5: The price here is an assumption, not the official price. To change the real SKU price, use the SKU Catalog page.
